# Pixel Dev — Pixel-Art Portfolio OS

A retro pixel-art portfolio styled as a macOS desktop, built by Pixel Dev, creative frontend engineer.

## What this page offers
- Boot-screen intro with 8-bit chiptune sounds (Web Audio API)
- macOS-style desktop: menu bar with live clock, floating pixel clouds, draggable sticky note
- Desktop icons for projects (Cyber Quest, Chiptune Studio, Pixel Paint AI, Pastel SaaS), About, Tech Stack, Resume, Contact
- Draggable, stackable, minimizable macOS-style windows
- Pixel girl character with speech bubbles standing above the dock
- Trash can easter egg containing "Rejected Concepts"
